scenario.title: 跟老朋友深夜談心
scenario.context: 第七章的收尾：跟老朋友聊到凌晨，話題從工作、夢想到後悔。你會用到 wish（真希望）、第三類條件句（如果當初）、讓步（儘管），還有這一章的觀點表達。這是全課程情緒最深的一次對話。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Can I ask you something personal? Do you ever regret quitting your agency job?
lines.zh: 我可以問你一個私人問題嗎？你會後悔辭掉廣告公司的工作嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Sometimes. Even though I love freelancing, I wish I had more stability.
lines.zh: 有時候會。雖然我很愛接案，但真希望能更穩定一點。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: But if you hadn't quit, you wouldn't have found your own style.
lines.zh: 但如果你當初沒辭職，你就不會找到自己的風格。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: True. Despite the stress, I've grown more in two years than in the five before.
lines.zh: 也對。儘管壓力很大，這兩年我的成長比之前五年還多。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I feel like I'm at a crossroads. I don't know if I should stay or go abroad.
lines.zh: 我覺得我站在十字路口，不知道該留下還是出國。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Fear, mostly. If only I were brave like you.
lines.zh: 大部分是恐懼。要是我能像你一樣勇敢就好了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I wasn't brave. I was scared the whole time. I just did it anyway.
lines.zh: 我不勇敢，我一直都很害怕，只是還是做了。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Thanks for this heart-to-heart. I needed it.
lines.zh: 謝謝這次的談心，我需要這個。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Anytime. The older we get, the more these talks matter.
lines.zh: 隨時。我們年紀越大，這種對話就越重要。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: I think I'll apply. If I don't, I'll wish I had.
lines.zh: 我想我會申請。如果不申請，我會後悔沒申請。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: That's the spirit. And if it doesn't work out, you just go with the flow.
lines.zh: 這就對了。如果不成功，就順其自然吧。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Ha, nobody says that anymore. But yes.
lines.zh: 哈，現在已經沒人這樣說了。但是沒錯。

patterns.en: Can I ask you something personal?
patterns.zh: 我可以問你一個私人問題嗎？

patterns.en: If I don't try, I'll always wonder.
Looking back, I wish I had ___.

chinglish.wrong: If I didn't quit, I wouldn't find my style.
chinglish.right: If I hadn't quit, I wouldn't have found my style.
chinglish.why: 講過去的假設要用第三類條件句（複習第 64 單元）。
不可能的願望用 wish（複習第 68 單元）。

chinglish.wrong: Despite I was scared, I did it.
chinglish.right: Even though I was scared, I did it. / Despite being scared, I did it.
chinglish.why: despite 不接子句（複習第 63 單元）。

grammar.title: wish、type 3、讓步
grammar.oneLiner: 談人生選擇的三個工具：wish（遺憾）、if + had + p.p.（當初如果）、even though / despite（儘管）。
whenToUse: wish + 過去式：現在的遺憾。I wish I had more time.
wish + had + p.p.：過去的遺憾。I wish I had started earlier.
type 3：If I hadn't quit, I wouldn't have found my style.
讓步：Even though I love it, … / Despite the stress, …
the more… the more…：The older we get, the more we value friends.
對未來的後悔預測：If I don't apply, I'll wish I had.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 這一章所有「假設」和「遺憾」的文法都在做同一件事：用往過去退一格的時態，表達「跟現實不同」。中文用「要是」「早知道」「真希望」加上語氣來表達，英文則靠時態精準區分現在的遺憾、過去的遺憾、還有可能的未來。整合單元把這些放在同一段對話裡，是練習切換的好機會。

examples.correct: I wish I had traveled more in my twenties.
examples.incorrect: I wish I traveled more in my twenties.
examples.note: 過去的遺憾用 had + p.p.。

examples.correct: If I had taken that job, I would have moved to Tokyo.
Even though it was risky, I don't regret it.
The more I think about it, the more sure I am.

If I ___ that class, I wouldn't have met my best friend.
___ the risks, she decided to start her own business.
The ___ I get to know you, the more I like you.

examples.en: We had a real heart-to-heart last night.
I think you two need a heart-to-heart.
examples.zh: 我覺得你們兩個需要好好談談。

slang.meaning: 站在十字路口、面臨重大抉擇
slang.usage: 人生或事業面臨重要的轉折點。

examples.en: I'm at a crossroads in my career.
examples.zh: 我的職涯走到十字路口了。

examples.en: The company is at a crossroads: grow fast or stay small.
examples.zh: 公司面臨抉擇：快速擴張或保持小規模。

examples.en: I don't plan my weekends. I just go with the flow.
examples.zh: 我週末不排計畫，就順其自然。

examples.en: She's very go-with-the-flow. Nothing stresses her out.
examples.zh: 她很隨遇而安，什麼事都不會讓她焦慮。

slang.meaning: 人生只有一次（You Only Live Once）
slang.usage: 2012 年左右爆紅，用來為衝動的決定找理由。

risk.note: 現在聽起來很過時，多半被拿來自嘲或開玩笑。認真說會顯得有點尷尬。

examples.en: I booked a last-minute flight to Bali. YOLO!
examples.zh: 我臨時訂了去峇里島的機票，人生只有一次！

examples.en: People used to say YOLO, but now it sounds so 2012.
examples.zh: 以前大家都說 YOLO，但現在聽起來很 2012 年。

options: You might want to think about going abroad.

review.explanation: go with the flow = 順其自然。
